boundary: The base physical/ninjutsu damage candidates, ordinary per-hit success gate, and the shared requirement for an effective hit before effect dispatch are closed. Status-specific operations, facing/terrain special cases, critical and ignore-defense trigger probabilities, linked attacks, and healing still require separate bindings.
conclusion: The queued attack stores four integer damage candidates before animation. The natural three-hit sample queues normal defended damage 9 and resolves 18 total damage, which uniquely requires two normal hits and one miss; the visible template value 6x3 is not final damage. The queue scans the same per-hit results before dispatching any effect handler, so a non-damage opponent effect with no effective hit must not apply its handler.
method: Validate the original-ROM event-builder, per-hit RNG instructions, shared effective-hit dispatch gate, and effect 0x3F handler, then recompute all four queued damage candidates from a natural three-hit ninja-tool checkpoint and require the resolved HP delta to have a unique outcome composition.
